name: Pelagic amphipod
desc: An open-water amphipod, often compared to krill. Golomyanka and Baikal seals eat it.
about: Macrohectopus branickii is a species of amphipod (a group containing the scuds) living in the pelagic zone of Lake Baikal, believed to be the only species of amphipod in this niche within freshwater.
